baseline: Frozen Phase 10F System B; retain A and C as historical/context comparators.
confirmatory_followup: Only after pilot protocol freeze, compare B vs B+ on all 188 labeled DEV claims, with the 112 unlabeled claims retained for operational/retrieval analysis and no correctness score. Since DEV has already informed diagnosis, report as development evidence; reserve a separately authorized test-set study for generalization.
go_no_go: Proposed prospective GO: B+ point estimate at least +5 percentage points absolute paired accuracy and paired 95% CI lower bound >0 on confirmatory run. Five points is a proposed minimum practical effect (one additional correct claim per 20 labeled claims), not estimated from this run; preregister before B+ results are seen. Pilot is feasibility only; do not treat a noisy pilot as efficacy evidence.
guardrails: Pre-register retrieval Recall@1 non-inferiority margin of −5 percentage points and invalid/unavailable output increase limit +2 percentage points; these are design tolerances and must be frozen prospectively. Always report coverage, execution failures, latency and calls. If not met, report no-go/indeterminate; no post-hoc threshold changes.
intervention: B+ changes exactly one factor: structured evidence-to-component mapping and auditable stance aggregation, subject to a separate implementation phase. Do not simultaneously change retriever, model, prompts beyond the defined factor, controller, and evidence budget.
pilot: If implementation is later authorized, run paired B/B+ on a fixed, seed-2026, proportional-stratified 60-claim DEV subset (39 SUPPORTED, 21 CONTRADICTED, exact IDs generated and frozen before execution). Include A/C only as unchanged context arms if budget permits. This is an exploratory pilot, not confirmation.
power: Use the pilot discordant-pair rate only for a blinded sample-size calculation, not to tune the model; determine whether all 188 DEV labels can detect the 5-point target. If inadequate, label results exploratory and plan separately authorized external validation.
pre-intervention_diagnostic: Blinded human audit of a deterministic stratified set of persisted wrong labeled outputs and matched correct outputs. Two reviewers label evidence adequacy, selection, contradiction, claim complexity, insufficiency, and ambiguity; adjudicate disagreement. This diagnoses before implementation and does not tune the verifier.
primary_metric: Paired labeled-claim accuracy (valid output denominator plus coverage/failure reported separately); report paired difference and 95% paired bootstrap CI, with exact McNemar test for discordant correctness pairs.
same_controls: same claim text and SciFact version
same corpus and retrieval settings unless the single intervention is selection only
same claim selection, order, seed, evidence budget and output schema
same gold labels joined only after execution
no retries or pre-registered retry policy applied identically
persist every attempt and denominator state
